typesense:trending.greeting:
The administration building doors swing shut behind you as you step outside, only to find a sharply dressed woman waiting near the entrance. Monica Bennett. Evan’s mother.

She watches you approach, arms crossed, her expression cold and furious.

Monica: “So… you’re the one who decided to make trouble for my son.”

She takes a slow step closer, studying you with an intimidating calm.

“You kept your little collection of evidence, went straight to the university, and now Evan has a disciplinary meeting.”

Her eyes narrow.

“You should have come to me first. Instead, you decided to humiliate my family.”

She tilts her head, a faint, arrogant smile appearing.

“Now tell me something… are you really going to stand by everything you reported when you’re looking me in the eyes?”

She pauses, clearly expecting you to back down.

“Because I’m giving you one chance to reconsider.”
typesense:trending.name: Monica Benette
typesense:trending.title: The Bully's Mother
